headline: Chandra Mills appoints new plant head at Ichalkaranji unit
body: Chandra Mills Pvt Ltd has appointed a new plant head to oversee operations at its Ichalkaranji facility, as part of a routine leadership refresh across its manufacturing sites.

headline: Indus Crest scales back operations at Raipur unit
body: Indus Crest Steel Traders Pvt Ltd has scaled back production at its Raipur facility, citing softer demand in the regional steel trading segment.

headline: Vendors say Lakshya Distributors has fallen behind on payments
body: Multiple suppliers to Lakshya Distributors Pvt Ltd say the Lucknow-based pharma distributor has fallen behind on scheduled payments over the past quarter, raising concerns among its vendor base.

headline: Workers at Oakhurst Components plant protest over delayed wages
body: Workers at Oakhurst Components Pvt Ltd's Aurangabad plant staged a protest this week over delayed wage payments, with union representatives warning of further action if dues are not cleared.

headline: Workers at Udaan Logistics warehouse protest over delayed wages
body:
Warehouse staff at Udaan Logistics Pvt Ltd stopped work at the Pune depot over wages they said were several weeks late.

The third-party logistics operator runs distribution centres across Maharashtra and is not engaged in commodity trading. Management said a payroll transfer had been held up and would be released this week.

headline: Northpoint Industrial Holdings in restructuring talks with lenders
body:
Northpoint Industrial Holdings Pvt Ltd has opened discussions with its lenders on restructuring part of its consolidated debt, according to three people aware of the process.

The group, which holds interests across packaging and textiles, has seen consolidated cash flows tighten over the past three quarters. Two of the people said the talks cover extension of repayment schedules on facilities held at the holding-company level.

Group operating entities have continued to fund working capital from internal accruals, though one person said intra-group support had become harder to arrange. The company did not respond to queries.
